summary: Phase 3.7.2 Orion Command Center frontend E2E. Verified Admin Hub Orion card (founder visible / support hidden), navigation, Mission Control sidebar/stats/status panel, Orion Chat with thinking state + persistence, mobile layout, and Cmd+K palette. 49/52 checks passed. ONE CRITICAL BUG found: Cmd+K palette never opens because <CommandPalette/> is defined but not rendered in AdminOrion JSX tree (listener fires, defaultPrevented=true confirmed, but no UI mounts).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Cmd+K (and Meta+K) palette never opens. Keydown listener in AdminOrion.jsx (lines 140-151) fires successfully (preventDefault verified via programmatic dispatch returning defaultPrevented:true) and toggles paletteOpen state, but the <CommandPalette open={paletteOpen} .../> component is NEVER rendered in the AdminOrion JSX. grep '<CommandPalette' returns zero hits. The function is defined at line 1086 but never instantiated. Palette overlay [data-testid='orion-cc-palette'] never mounts.

action_items: Render the CommandPalette component inside AdminOrion's return JSX. Example: <CommandPalette open={paletteOpen} onClose={() => setPaletteOpen(false)} onSection={(id) => { setActive(id); setPaletteOpen(false); }} onPrompt={(p) => { setPendingPrompt(p); setActive('chat'); setPaletteOpen(false); }} />. Place it as a sibling near the end of the orion-cc-root div so it overlays everything. After fix, verify Ctrl+K opens overlay, typing 'brief' filters rows, Enter selects, Esc closes.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOrion.jsx:140-151 — Cmd+K keydown handler attached at window level WITHOUT a check that focus is inside an input/textarea. As written, pressing Ctrl+K while typing in the chat input or palette input itself would still toggle and call preventDefault. Consider adding `if (['INPUT','TEXTAREA'].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName)) return;` (with an allow-list for the palette input).
AdminOrion.jsx ~1110 — When palette CommandPalette IS wired in, focus the input on open via inputRef.current?.focus() inside a useEffect on `open` so the user can start typing immediately.
AdminHub.jsx:138 — visibleCards filter uses (role==='founder' && c.roles.includes('admin')). roleOf already maps founder so this OR is redundant but harmless. Cosmetic only.

rca of the issue: Cmd+K palette: function component `CommandPalette` is exported/defined at AdminOrion.jsx:1086 but no `` JSX tag exists anywhere in the file (grep returns 0 hits). State `paletteOpen` toggles fine, but with nothing consuming it the overlay never renders. Reproduction: as founder, visit /admin/orion, press Ctrl+K → no overlay; programmatic window.dispatchEvent of KeyboardEvent {key:'k', ctrlKey:true} shows defaultPrevented=true (proving listener fires) yet [data-testid='orion-cc-palette'] count remains 0. Mitigation: add ` setPaletteOpen(false)} onSection={handleSection} onPrompt={handlePrompt} />` inside AdminOrion's return tree (e.g., just before the closing of orion-cc-root).
